why_agent_cannot: find the official site from the project's own profile
what_human_must_do: No official domain was extracted. Find it from the project's own profile first.
steps_from_source: Check that QFEX accepts users from your country before you sign up. Warning The FAQ lists the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, Ukraine, Russia, Belarus, Iran, Syria, North Korea, Myanmar, Venezuela and Sudan as blocked, and says the list is "not limited to" those.
Create an account at qfex.com with Google, Apple, a wallet or an email address.
Complete identity verification. The app doesn't let you trade before it is done.
Deposit USDC on Arbitrum One to the address shown in the app. The docs warn: "Deposits sent using a different asset or network may be lost."
If you want the Loss Refunds draw, link your X account and register in the Rewards Hub. Do this again every week.

Trade. At the entry tier, index and commodity trades cost 0.05% as a taker and 0.02% as a maker, and single stocks cost 0.10% and 0.05%. Warning This is leveraged trading with real money. QFEX warns of "the risk of losing more than your initial deposit", and its terms say: "You may be liquidated without prior notice."
